title: CRM, CTI, and CPaaS
blurb: Salesforce CTI URLs from the public pages, Integration Hub limits, and a CPaaS line with no URL.

lessons.title: The Salesforce CTI adapter URL
lessons.summary: Agent Workspace for Salesforce is Lightning only. The install creates two call centers. The non-FedRAMP CTI adapter URL and the FedRAMP URL are different hosts. Anything under 365 pixels wide is not supported.
objectives: Paste the URL for the right boundary

p: The install page says Agent Workspace for Salesforce runs in Salesforce Lightning and is compatible with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Marketing Cloud. The package needs an org that does not already have a namespace. If a contact center definition is already named NiCE CXone Contact Center, rename it before install or the install fails while creating that definition.

Supported Salesforce editions on the page are Professional, Enterprise, Unlimited, Developer, and Performance. A first AppExchange install includes 25 trial licenses for 30 days. A sandbox does not need licenses. Active seat counts go through the account representative. Users must be assigned to the package license or the app does not load. The publisher shown is CXAE_Salesforce.

cites.title: Install Agent Workspace (Embedded) (Agent Embedded) in Salesforce

p: The install adds two call centers: CXone Agent for Salesforce and CXone Agent for Salesforce FedRamp. Older call centers should not be used. The non-FedRAMP CTI Adapter URL is https://cxagent.nicecxone.com/login?base=https://login.salesforce.com/&app=cxa_sfdc. The FedRAMP Moderate URL uses https://cxagent.nicecxone-gov.com with the same path and query. Recommended softphone size is 700 pixels high and 420 pixels wide. Less than 365 pixels is not supported.
Add the Open CTI Softphone utility item on each Lightning app, under Utility Items (Desktop Only). Assign users to one of the two new call centers.

lessons.title: Trusted URLs and Click2Jack
lessons.summary: Salesforce must trust cxagent.nicecxone.com and api.incontact.com. Click2Jack wants your own Lightning and My Domain hosts. It can block non-agent users who still carry NiCE components.

p: The install page says to add cxagent.nicecxone.com and api.incontact.com as trusted URLs. For each one, create a trusted URL, and select every checkbox in the CSP Directives section. The page's example API names are NICECXone and NiCE CXone API. The install itself also asks you to grant access to api.incontact.com.
Those are host names on the page, not a full allowlist of every CXone service.

cites.title: Install Agent Workspace (Embedded) (Agent Embedded) in Salesforce

p: Under Session Settings, add your own https://mydomain.lightning.force.com and https://mydomain.my.salesforce.com, replacing mydomain. The page says Click2Jack also helps with third-party cookie changes.

It can cause trouble for non-agent Salesforce users. They may be unable to open Lightning components or Visualforce pages if they are assigned a NiCE call center, the NiCE softphone utility, a Lightning app with NiCE components, or a Visualforce page with NiCE components.

lessons.title: A second CTI URL, 340 pixels wide
lessons.summary: Fully integrated Lightning uses /apex/icAgentConsole__agent, height 700, and width 340. That is not the embedded adapter URL and not the 420-pixel width.

p: The fully integrated Lightning page says that after users are on the call center profile, you edit that call center. Add /apex/icAgentConsole__agent to the CTI Adapter URL. Set height to 700 and width to 340. Set Salesforce Compatibility Mode to Lightning. Save.
The embedded install page's URL is a cxagent host, and its recommended width is 420. These are two procedures. This lab does not merge them into one URL.

lessons.title: Integration Hub: 50 connections, 32 KB
lessons.summary: Integration Hub stores REST connections so Studio does not hold tokens in plain text. My Connections holds at most 50 connections. Each connection holds at most 50 requests. Responses are limited to 32 KB. One sentence on the page says there is one system template, then the page lists five.

p: Integration Hub is in the Connections Hub application and needs the Launch Connections Hub permission. It builds a REST request once and reuses it from Studio. Credentials are encrypted so they are not stored as plain-text script variables. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 or none. Secrets use AES and are decrypted only at execution.

The page says there are five default system templates, for the CXone developer portal, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Zendesk. They use OAuth 2.0 and the verbs GET, PUT, POST, DELETE, and PATCH. They do not ship default headers. A later sentence says Integration Hub includes one system template, and then the same five names appear. This lab keeps both sentences and does not decide which count wins.

You can create at most 50 connections in My Connections. Templates in the library are not capped. Custom templates can be deleted without deleting the connections made from them. System templates cannot be deleted. Templates cannot be modified. Each connection can have up to 50 requests. There is a 32 KB limit on response size. The page says to filter with query parameters.

Studio actions are CONNECTAUTH and CONNECTREQUEST. The circuit breaker trips when more than 50 percent of calls to one API fail within 30 seconds and Integration Hub has tried more than 100 calls to that API in that window. It then throttles for 30 seconds. Failures land in the _err trace variable.

lessons.title: UCaaS (1CX) is not a CPaaS page
lessons.summary: UCaaS (Basic) (1CX) is a 3CX product integrated with CXone. It is not sold alone. The connectivity page allows VoIP on the agent leg and says some UCaaS partners can allow VoIP on the A leg. Neither page is titled CPaaS.
objectives: Sync presence with the agent app

nodes.label: A leg VoIP
nodes.sub: ask, if a partner allows it

p: The UCaaS page says NiCE CXone UCaaS (Basic) (1CX) provides voice, video, and chat inside an organization, plus voicemail, email, and SMS in one place. It is a 3CX product integrated with CXone. It is not available as a standalone product. Configuration goes through the account representative. The 3CX manuals are the usage docs the page points at.

Presence syncs with Agent Workspace (Agent), MAX, or Salesforce Agent. Handling an interaction in the agent application shows the user unavailable in 1CX. Users can also set status by hand. Each user has a dedicated number, from NiCE or ported. Telephony can be NiCE or bring-your-own-carrier for local DID, national, and international. Instant messages and DID texts stay inside the 1CX platform.

The connectivity page says both PSTN and VoIP can be used on the agent leg. CXone supports PSTN on the A leg and restricts VoIP to the agent leg. Some UCaaS partners allow VoIP on the A leg. The page says to talk to the account representative if you need that.
That sentence uses the words Unified Communications as a Service. It does not name a CPaaS product, an API catalog, or a bridge to another contact center.

lessons.title: CPaaS stays confirm
lessons.summary: No NiCE help page opened for this chapter uses CPaaS as a product name. The Agentic Engagement Plane is a real, different page. Five9 and Webex Contact Center stay confirm.
objectives: Describe AEP only from its page
Not invent a Five9 or Webex connector

p: A search for a CXone CPaaS page returned the connectivity page, the UCaaS (1CX) page, and the Agentic Engagement Plane. None of those pages names a CPaaS product or a CPaaS bridge. The CPaaS line in this lab is confirm. There is no URL.

The Agentic Engagement Plane page describes an orchestration layer above the CCaaS, whether that CCaaS is CXone or another platform. Three pillars are named: Any Channel, Any AI Agent, and Any Human Agent. Cognigy is named as a native AI agent, and third-party or customer-built agents are allowed. A human can be on CXone or on another connected CCaaS. The channel and the thread stay fixed while the handler changes. The page does not list a click-by-click setup, so this lesson does not invent one.

The third-party ACD page names Engagement Hub for Avaya CMS and Amazon Connect, an SDK path for Smart Reach, and point-to-point for Cisco UCCE, Cisco UCCX, and Avaya CMS_Legacy. Five9 is not in that list. Webex Contact Center is not in that list. Both stay confirm, with no URL.

Integration Hub's system templates name the developer portal, Dynamics 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Zendesk. That list is not a CPaaS catalog and it is not a Five9 or Webex Contact Center connector.
